1 Introduction Nickel superalloys exhibit several superlative properties—exceptional mechanical strength, creep re- sistance, and thermal stability—that have led to their widespread adoption in critical applications like turbine blades in modern jet engines
These superalloys exhibit distinct phases: the γ phase with the FCC lattice, composed primarily of Ni, and the ordered γ′ phase of Ni Al with the L1 structure
